• 1am auto-dev session (2026-09-13). Telegram empty, no pending commands.
• To-Do board dry: only open item is the parked Career Highs mid-season peak MMR (pending Lok's season_history schema call) - not touched.
• No Daily Log row existed for today (6am plan has not run yet) - created by this session.
• Board-dry code audit (Step 2b): reviewed BracketCard Bo3 score display (no longer buggy, already refactored to truncate+tooltip), the previously-logged chat/tournaments lossy lookupUserByUid rebuild (already fixed, both spread the full profile correctly now), clubRivalry.ts + its ClubDetailClient usage (correct), find-a-coach page (clean), ChallengeModal (already hardened). All clean, no action needed.
• Confirmed + fixed 1 real bug: achievements.ts compared match.winnerId against user.uid to decide First Win/Hot Streak/Comeback King/Giant Slayer, but winnerId is always normalized to the 'me' sentinel (toLocalMatch) - never the real uid. Every real signed-in account could never earn those 4 badges; only the local demo profile (uid 'me') ever did. The selfcheck's own USER fixture used uid: 'me', which is exactly why the test suite never caught it. Fixed all 3 comparison sites + hardened the fixture to a realistic uid.
• Checked live public site (Rankings/Events) - clean, no console errors, empty states are correct (no real ranked players yet).
• Board still dry (only open item is the parked schema-blocked Career Highs bug) - ran Step 2b bug hunt/code audit instead. Found + fixed a MAJOR real bug: matches/challenges/clubs/conversations from useApp() normalize the signed-in users own side to the me sentinel (see toLocalMatch etc.), but many screens compared against user.uid (the real uid) instead - same class as the achievements.ts fix but far more spread. Broken: home page win streak (always 0), Recent Form dots (always all losses), pending-match banner (always Reported
